change: Order unimodal absolute-distance axis costs by reversing the decreasing prefix, repairing equal-cost plateaus, and merging with the increasing suffix. Retain lexicographic cost/coordinate ordering; no persistent cache or search pruning.

proof.oracle: Independent std::sort on empty/single/explicit plateau and generated axes spanning five steps, seven anchors, four half extents, three clipped starts and five lengths.
proof.coverage: Includes anchors far outside the board and floating-point distance plateaus; existing geometry digest, precision-operation observers, exception paths and model failure receipts pass.
proof.tests: occupancy_precision, policy_audits and model_failure_receipt: 3/3 PASS in 47.06s

microbenchmark.workload: 64 axes x 320 coordinates x 200 repetitions per method, four alternating-order rounds; identical input copying and checksum consumption.

limits: The microbenchmark improvement is not an end-to-end speedup. Full carrier duration was similar to the earlier diagnostic run; conditions are not a controlled paired comparison. No fresh full build/render, because accepted geometry is identical. Broader goal incomplete.
